anomalies.name: BigBufferNoXrefMediumToHighEntropy
anomalies.desc: a medium-to-high-entropy 10KB+ buffer, which is not part of a known structure and has no cross-reference inside: most likely a big crypto data block. File must have at least one function for this anomaly to run

anomalies.name: CrossSectionJump
anomalies.desc: Control flow jumps across section, could be a packed file, a patched file or a file infector

anomalies.name: ExecutableSectionNoCode
anomalies.desc: executable section has the flag code not set

anomalies.name: HugeFunctionGapAtSectionBoundary
anomalies.desc: There is a huge gap between start/end of executable section and first/last function of a section with medium-to-high entropy (which is not a know structure). It often means that data is stored there

anomalies.name: InvalidSizeOfInitializedData
anomalies.desc: SizeOfInitializedData is not the sum of all ininitalized data sections (raw or virtual)

anomalies.name: ManyHighValueImmediates
anomalies.desc: Function contains at least 5 and more than 10% of high-value immediate operands (i.e. immediate values that contains at least 2 non-zero non-FF bytes and are not a valid address)

anomalies.name: ManyUniqueImmediateBytes
anomalies.desc: More than 48 unique bytes defined across all immediate operands in the function

anomalies.name: RelocSectionNoRelocation
anomalies.desc: .reloc section does not contains relocations

anomalies.name: RichUnknownTool
anomalies.desc: Tool entry is not known (either a new version or has been patched)

anomalies.name: SectionWX
anomalies.desc: section is executable and writeable

anomalies.name: SequentialFunction
anomalies.desc: function with very little intra jumps and calls, usually a crypto function, unrolled loops or data initialisation

anomalies.name: SpaghettiFunction
anomalies.desc: Function with lots of intra jumps, could be obfuscated

anomalies.name: UnbalancedVirtualPhysicalRatio
anomalies.desc: huge difference between the physical and virtual size of a section

anomalies.name: WeirdDebugInfoType
anomalies.desc: the Debug infos are not in the usual format

anomalies.name: XorInLoop
anomalies.desc: XOR instruction in a loop
